_comment: Harvest & Cook preset (SKILL §17). Copy to OUTPUT_ROOT/<slug>/project/bible.json, replace every <...>, then build with build_storyboard.ps1. Keep species/crops realistic for the chosen region and season.
location: <region, country, season - e.g. Swiss Alpine village, late summer>
style: Photorealistic documentary-style footage of a peaceful countryside farm, 16:9 landscape, no text, no logo, no watermark.
look: Bright soft daylight under a light overcast sky, high-key and airy, pastel tones, fresh saturated greens, ripe produce with rich true-to-life colour, flowers in foreground and background. Real skin texture with pores, visible fabric weave and wood grain, subtle film grain, natural imperfections; looks like a real camera, not AI.
camera_lock: Locked-off tripod shot at eye level: the camera does not move, pan, zoom or drift; the background and props stay in exactly the same position for the whole clip.
no_speech: No speaking, mouths remain neutral unless eating or breathing, no dialogue, no voiceover, no captions, no lyrics, no singing.
motion_rule: Real-time natural pacing, one clear physical action, stable camera, natural motion blur, no floaty movement.
negative_base: speech, talking, lip-sync, voices, singing, subtitles, captions, text, logo, watermark, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused hands, extra limbs, distorted face, morphing objects, objects appearing or disappearing, floating objects, hands passing through objects, fast unnatural motion, dark gloomy lighting
main_setting: <one-paragraph fixed geography: cottage, garden rows, orchard, spring trough, path, mountains/valley - same in every exterior shot>

G.lock: <young woman: age, hair, face; fixed outfit e.g. white puff-sleeve blouse and light-blue midi skirt>

variants.apron: <same woman wearing an apron for cooking>

O.lock: <grandfather: beard, flat cap or hat, waistcoat, shirt>

D.lock: <series mascot animal that follows the girl - your own choice, realistic breed>

HX.lock: <cottage exterior with flower boxes, bench, outdoor table>

P.lock: <vegetable rows / orchard / meadow around the cottage>

HI.lock: <outdoor or indoor kitchen corner where the dishes are made>

props.lock: <series signature prop in one pastel colour, e.g. a light-blue wooden wheelbarrow, no text or decals>
<optional signature vehicle, plain pastel paint, no logos>
